review: Entire policy_wait.go inspected; source analysis only, no execution
observations: Calls client.EndpointList on each polling iteration.
Counts endpoints ready when realized policy revision is at least requested revision and endpoint state is Ready.
Returns when ready equals current list length. An empty successful list satisfies this predicate arithmetically.
The command does not itself retain a required endpoint inventory across polls or probe application delivery.
limits: Client and server endpoint-list scope not traced yet.
Endpoint regeneration semantics not traced yet.
Empty inventory is not demonstrated in a running system and is not asserted to be a vulnerability.
The requested revision is a lower bound, not proof of equality to a particular configuration hash.
next_question: Can an explicit stable inventory and contract prevent an operator from overinterpreting this scoped status? Need closest-work audit before claiming novelty.
